description: Main source file for a Zephyr-based CAN socket communication sample, including setup, transmission, and reception of CAN frames with threading and socket management.

methods.name: tx
methods.description: Thread function to send CAN frames periodically.

methods.name: create_socket
methods.description: Creates and binds a CAN socket with specified filter.

methods.name: rx
methods.description: Thread function to receive CAN frames and handle socket recreation.

methods.name: setup_socket
methods.description: Initializes CAN socket, starts TX thread, and optionally creates RX thread.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point to initialize CAN device, configure loopback, start CAN controller, and run socket setup and receive loop.
